style.backgroundSystem: alternating electric-blue #2B5BF0 graphic fields with one soft vertical light streak and warm off-white #F7F5F2 layout panels; brick-red #C0233C only for contaminant and spec blocks; deep navy #14276B for data and diagram plates
style.direction: clinical HVAC consumer commerce, flat colour-block graphic screens alternating with clean packshots
style.iconSystem: flat thin-line pictograms inside blank white circular chips, single stroke weight, no gradients, no shading, no captions
style.lightingSystem: packshots lit bright even high-key at 5600K from the front-left with a soft fill and one soft contact shadow; graphic screens lit flat and shadowless with the same upper-left light direction across the whole set; macro lit with a cool low-intensity skimming sweep
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical home-improvement HVAC ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of electric blue #2B5BF0, deep navy #14276B, warm off-white #F7F5F2 and one brick-red accent #C0233C; cool neutral lighting at 5600K, front-left key for packshots with one soft contact shadow and flat shadowless graphic light for screens, one consistent light direction; modern geometric sans-serif with oversized headline bands and one short label row per element; flat thin-line circular pictogram icons in white, single stroke weight, no gradients; graphic colour-block fields alternating with clean packshots and exactly two real photographs; stable upright square-to-frame product scale; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no photographic backgrounds on graphic screens, no inconsistent light direction, no real brand marks or badge artwork, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no photographic backgrounds on graphic screens
no inconsistent light direction between paired panels
no real brand marks, ratings or badge artwork
no invented numbers inside chart bars, spec blocks or ladder rungs
style.presentationRules: pack always upright and square to the frame on graphic fields, identical scale between paired panels, filter media shown at the same edge-on or face-on attitude, product never clipped
style.surfaceSystem: seamless warm off-white studio sweep #F7F5F2 for packshots, matte navy plates #14276B for diagram cells, real concrete floor and painted drywall only inside the two installation photos
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, oversized headline band, one short label row per element, generous margins, every word left as a blank slot or a callout placeholder
